n605f4683ac.headline: La Jornada: Taxes Will Not Increase, AMLO Confirms to Businesspeople
n605f4683ac.summary: President Andrés Manuel López Obrador assured business leaders that taxes will not increase, emphasizing investment and job creation as priorities.
n605f4683ac.why: Mexico's fiscal policy stance affects investor confidence and economic growth prospects in Latin America's second-largest economy.
